title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
Part 1 is in. `observeMutations` records one `mutation` event per observer callback for a simple add, remove, attribute change, or text change, and `stop()` disconnects.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Left open: Parts 2–5 (batch ordering and edge cases, privacy on later edits, the rebuild helper, and the seeded fuzz test). The issue definition of done is not met until those land.
